-- =============================================
-- Author:		Thilina
-- Create date: <Create Date,,>
-- Description:	Calculate Levy amount
-- select * from [dbo].[fnCalculateLevyAmount](316698)
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnCalculateLevyAmount]
(
	@applicationId int
)
RETURNS 
@LevyTable TABLE 
(
	LevyTypeName varchar(500),
	LevyAmount money,
	FeeTypeId int
)
AS
BEGIN
	
	Declare @CostOfWork money;
	declare @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW money;
	declare @NotApplicableCladdingLevyCOW money;
	declare @TotalApplicableNotApplicableCOW money;

	declare @LandOwnershipTypeID int;
	declare @LandOwnershipTypeName varchar(100);
	declare @SeperateFeeForCladdinglevy int = null;
	declare @applicationTypeId int;
	declare @LicenceId int;

	declare @GeneralLevy money = 0.00;
	declare @DBDRVLevy money = 0.00;
	declare @CladdingLevy money= 0.00;
	declare @TotalLevy money = 0.00;
	
	-- Get Application Cost of works , Applicable,Not applicable
	select @CostOfWork = CostOfDevelopment,@ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW = ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW,@NotApplicableCladdingLevyCOW=NotApplicableCladdingLevyCOW,@LicenceId = LicenceID,@applicationTypeId = ApplicationTypeID  from Application where ApplicationID = @applicationId
	
	-- Get Land Ownership type
	select top 1 @LandOwnershipTypeID = p.LandOwnershipTypeID,@LandOwnershipTypeName=l.LandOwnershipTypeName from Property p JOIN LandOwnershipType l on p.LandOwnershipTypeID=l.LandOwnershipTypeID where ApplicationID = @applicationId
	order by PropertyID

	-- Get Value for separate or not cladding levy from General Levy
	select @SeperateFeeForCladdinglevy = SeperateFeeForCladdinglevy from ApplicationTypeSetting ats
	join Application a on a.ApplicationTypeID = ats.ApplicationTypeID and a.LicenceID = ats.LicenceID
	where a.ApplicationID = @applicationId

	--Set 0 If NULL
	if @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW is null
		SET @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW = 0.00;
	if @NotApplicableCladdingLevyCOW is null
		SET @NotApplicableCladdingLevyCOW = 0.00;

     --total applicable and not applicable
	 set @TotalApplicableNotApplicableCOW = @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW + @NotApplicableCladdingLevyCOW

	if(@TotalApplicableNotApplicableCOW >= 10000 AND @LandOwnershipTypeName != 'Commonwealth Government - Crown Land')
	begin
		set @GeneralLevy = @TotalApplicableNotApplicableCOW * 0.00064;
		set @DBDRVLevy = @TotalApplicableNotApplicableCOW * 0.00064;
		-- Calculate cladding levy
		set @CladdingLevy =
			case
			when @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW < 800000
			then 0
			when @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW >= 800000 AND @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW <= 999999
			then @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW * 0.00128
			when @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW >= 1000000 AND @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW <= 1499999
			then @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW * 0.00256
			when @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW >= 1500000
			then @ApplicableCladdingLevyCOW * 0.0082
		end

		-- Add General levy and cladding levy if SeperateFeeForCladdinglevy
		IF(@SeperateFeeForCladdingLevy = 0 OR @SeperateFeeForCladdingLevy = NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @GeneralLevy = @GeneralLevy + @CladdingLevy + @DBDRVLevy;

			set @CladdingLevy = 0.00;

			set @DBDRVLevy = 0.00;
		END

		--Calculate Total Levy amount
		SET @TotalLevy = @GeneralLevy + @DBDRVLevy + @CladdingLevy;

	end

	--Get Fee type id
	declare @FeeTypeID int;
	select @FeeTypeID = FeeTypeId from FeeType where licenceId = @LicenceId and FeeTypeName like '%Permit Fee%'

	-- Get Fee Item
	declare @FeeItemID int = null;

	--select top 1 @FeeItemID = FeeItemID from FeeItem 
	--where LicenceID = @LicenceId and ApplicationTypeID = @applicationTypeId and [Description] like '%Council Fee%'

	-- insert general Levy
	insert into @LevyTable(LevyTypeName,LevyAmount,FeeTypeId)
	Values('Government Levy',@GeneralLevy,@FeeTypeId)

	-- insert Cladding Levy
	insert into @LevyTable(LevyTypeName,LevyAmount,FeeTypeId)
	values ('Cladding Levy',@CladdingLevy,@FeeTypeID)

	-- insert DBDRV Levy
	insert into @LevyTable(LevyTypeName,LevyAmount,FeeTypeId)
	values ('DBDRV Levy',@DBDRVLevy,@FeeTypeID)

	-- insert Cladding Levy
	insert into @LevyTable(LevyTypeName,LevyAmount)
	values ('Total Levy',@TotalLevy)

	
	RETURN 
END

-- Description:	Returns if the application is completed in the given date Range
-- =============================================
Create FUNCTION [dbo].[fnCheckIfCompleted]
(
	@ApplicationID INT,
	@DtStartDate DATE,
	@DtEndDate DATE
)
RETURNS BIT
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @IsCompleted BIT = NULL;
	
	SELECT @IsCompleted =
		CASE
			WHEN PPAR.FinalOutcomeDate BETWEEN @DtStartDate AND @DtEndDate THEN 1
			ELSE NULL
		END
	FROM ApplicationPPARDetails PPAR
	WHERE PPAR.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
	IF(@IsCompleted IS NULL)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @IsCompleted =
			CASE
				WHEN PPAR.ResponsibleAuthorityOutcomeDate BETWEEN @DtStartDate AND @DtEndDate THEN 1
				ELSE NULL
			END
		FROM ApplicationPPARDetails PPAR
		WHERE PPAR.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
	END
	
	IF(@IsCompleted IS NULL)	
		SET @IsCompleted = 0
	-- Return the result of the function
	RETURN @IsCompleted;


END

name: fnCreateAlphanumericSortValue
text:
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnCreateAlphanumericSortValue]
(
	@ItemToSort varchar(200),
	@SortNumericsFirst bit = 1
)
RETURNS varchar(801)
WITH SCHEMABINDING
AS
	--==========================================================================================
	-- This function takes an alphanumeric string and encodes it so that it can be properly sorted
	--    against other alphanumeric strings
	-- The encoding will insert a three digit string before each numeric portion of the item to sort
	--    The three digits represent the number of digits in the numeric portion that it will precede (zero-padded)
	-- The encoding will also account for leading zeros in each numeric portion by adding a three digit
	--    string at the end of the item to sort, for each numeric portion.  Those three digits will
	--    represent the number of leading zeros in the numeric portion (zero-padded)
	-- Examples:
	-- ABC =	  ABC
	-- ABC1 =     ABC0011 000
	-- ABC1ABC1 = ABC0011ABC0011 000000
	-- ABC12    = ABC00212 000
	-- ABC012   = ABC00212 001
	--
	-- Worst case notes:
	--	The max count of leading zeros is -- all zeros = 200
	--  The max count of numbers -- all numbers = 200
	--  A single space separates the leading zero string from the rest
	--	Leading zeros get trimmed
	--  Each number portion gets 3 new characters in front (and 3 new characters at the end)
	--			1 leading zero nets 2 characters
	--			2 leading zeros net 1 character
	--			3 leading zeros net 0 characters
	--			>3 lose characters
	--  All characters just spits out the same string
	--  So, no leading zeros, but with numbers, adds the most characters
	--	So, the most number-sets = the most characters -- which is every other is a number
	--			= 100 numbers & 100 alphas
	--			= 100 * 3 characters each in front + 100 * 3 characters each at then + 1 space
	--			= 801 characters
	-- FYI. This function is specifically being used for ... (some domain specific stuff)... sorting at this time.
	--    As such, everything has been set up for that length, which is 200 characters
	--    A change in that length could require numerous changes to to code below -- be careful.
	--		(If you can have > 999 numbers/zeros to count)
	--==========================================================================================
BEGIN
	declare @WorkingItem varchar(200) = @ItemToSort
	declare @DigitCount int = 0
	declare @LeadingZeroCount int = 0
	declare @CurrentNumber varchar(200) = ''
	declare @Leftmost varchar(1) = ''
	declare @LeadingZeroString varchar(300) = ''

	--==========================================================================================
	-- With 200 character input, the worst case output should be 801 characters
	--==========================================================================================
	declare @SortValue varchar(801) = ''	

	--==========================================================================================
	-- We will work thru the input string one character at a time
	--==========================================================================================
	declare @FirstIsCharacter bit = 0
	if (isnumeric(left(@WorkingItem, 1)) = 0)
		select @FirstIsCharacter = 1

	while (len(@WorkingItem) > 0)
	begin
		select @Leftmost = left(@WorkingItem, 1)

		--==========================================================================================
		-- Is the first character a number?
		--==========================================================================================
		if (isnumeric(@Leftmost) = 1 and @Leftmost != '-')
		begin
			while (isnumeric(@Leftmost) = 1 and @Leftmost != '-')
			begin
				--==========================================================================================
				-- Parse out all of the consecutive digits to get the current number
				--==========================================================================================
				if (@Leftmost = '0' and @DigitCount = 0)
				begin
					--==========================================================================================
					-- Leading zero -- just count how many we have in this set of digits
					--    We'll add the string for it to the end of our output below
					--==========================================================================================
					select @LeadingZeroCount = @LeadingZeroCount + 1
				end
				else
				begin
					--==========================================================================================
					-- Not a leading zero, so increment the digit count, and remember the current number value
					--==========================================================================================
					select @DigitCount = @DigitCount + 1
					select @CurrentNumber = @CurrentNumber + @Leftmost
				end

				--==========================================================================================
				-- Trim off the character we just checked, get the next character to check and continue the inner loop
				--==========================================================================================
				select @WorkingItem = substring(@WorkingItem, 2, 200)
				select @Leftmost = left(@WorkingItem, 1)
			end -- while (isnumeric(@Leftmost) = 1)

			--==========================================================================================
			-- We now have the current number from our input string
			--    Add the current number's leading zero string to the entire leading zero string, zero-padded
			--==========================================================================================
			if (@LeadingZeroCount < 10)
				select @LeadingZeroString = @LeadingZeroString + '00' + cast(@LeadingZeroCount as varchar)
			else if (@LeadingZeroCount < 100)
				select @LeadingZeroString = @LeadingZeroString + '0' + cast(@LeadingZeroCount as varchar)
			else
				select @LeadingZeroString = @LeadingZeroString + cast(@LeadingZeroCount as varchar)

			--==========================================================================================
			-- Add the current number's sort code, along with the current number, to the returned sort value
			--==========================================================================================
			if (@DigitCount < 10)
				select @SortValue = @SortValue + '00' + cast(@DigitCount as varchar) + @CurrentNumber
			else if (@DigitCount < 100)
				select @SortValue = @SortValue + '0' + cast(@DigitCount as varchar) + @CurrentNumber
			else
				select @SortValue = @SortValue + cast(@DigitCount as varchar) + @CurrentNumber

			--==========================================================================================
			-- Reset for the next iteration
			--==========================================================================================
			select @DigitCount = 0
			select @CurrentNumber = ''
			select @LeadingZeroCount = 0
		end -- if (isnumeric(@Leftmost) = 1)

		--==========================================================================================
		-- The character we are currently working with is not a number, just tag it onto our return value
		--    Ignoring whitespace
		--==========================================================================================
		if (@Leftmost != ' ')
			select @SortValue = @SortValue + @Leftmost

		--==========================================================================================
		-- Trim off the character we just checked and continue the main loop
		--==========================================================================================
		select @WorkingItem = substring(@WorkingItem, 2, 200)

	end -- while (len(@WorkingItem) > 0)

	if (@SortNumericsFirst = 0 and @FirstIsCharacter = 1)
		select @SortValue = '-999999999' + @SortValue

	--==========================================================================================
	-- Finally, tag on the leading zero value and return our sort value
	--==========================================================================================
	select @SortValue = @SortValue +  ' ' + @LeadingZeroString

	return @SortValue
END

CREATE function [dbo].[fnDynFeeGetDAAppFee]
(
	@CostOfWorks MONEY
)
RETURNS MONEY
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @NewCostOfWorks MONEY;	
	DECLARE @AdditionalCost MONEY;	
	DECLARE @MultiplyFactor MONEY;
	DECLARE @Quotient INT;
	DECLARE @Remainder INT;	

	IF (@CostOfWorks <= 5000)
	BEGIN
		SET @NewCostOfWorks = 110.00
		SET @MultiplyFactor = 1.0
	END

	ELSE IF ( @CostOfWorks > 5000 AND @CostOfWorks <=50000)
	BEGIN
		SET @NewCostOfWorks = 170.00
		SET @MultiplyFactor = 3.0
		SET @AdditionalCost = @CostOfWorks - 5000		
	END

	ELSE IF ( @CostOfWorks > 50000 AND @CostOfWorks <= 250000)
	BEGIN
		SET @NewCostOfWorks = 352.00
		SET @MultiplyFactor = 3.64
		SET @AdditionalCost = @CostOfWorks - 50000		
	END

	ELSE IF ( @CostOfWorks > 250000 AND @CostOfWorks <= 500000)
	BEGIN
		SET @NewCostOfWorks = 1160.00
		SET @MultiplyFactor = 2.34
		SET @AdditionalCost = @CostOfWorks - 250000		
	END

	ELSE IF ( @CostOfWorks > 500000 AND @CostOfWorks <= 1000000)
	BEGIN
		SET @NewCostOfWorks = 1745.00
		SET @MultiplyFactor = 1.64
		SET @AdditionalCost = @CostOfWorks - 500000		
	END

	ELSE IF ( @CostOfWorks > 1000000 AND @CostOfWorks <= 10000000)
	BEGIN
		SET @NewCostOfWorks = 2615.00
		SET @MultiplyFactor = 1.44
		SET @AdditionalCost = @CostOfWorks - 1000000		
	END

	IF(@AdditionalCost > 0)
		BEGIN
			SET @Quotient = @AdditionalCost / 1000;
			SET @Remainder = @AdditionalCost % 1000;
			IF(@Remainder > 0)
				SET @Quotient = @Quotient + 1
		SET @NewCostOfWorks = @NewCostOfWorks + (@Quotient * @MultiplyFactor)
		END
	

	RETURN @NewCostOfWorks

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetAdditionalDaysFeeForSkipBins] 
(
	-- Add the parameters for the function here
	@ApplicationID                      INT,
    @FeeItemID                          INT,
    @Quantity                           FLOAT,
    @WizzardName                        VARCHAR(100),
    @FieldID                            VARCHAR(500),
    @InputValue                         VARCHAR(50),
    @Operation                          TINYINT,
    @AdditionalApplicationRequestID     INT,
	@StepID								VARCHAR(100)
)
RETURNS @ApplicationFee TABLE
(
	ApplicationID INT NULL,
	FeeItemName VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	StepID VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	UnitPrice MONEY NULL,
	Quantity FLOAT NULL,
	TotalPrice MONEY NULL,
	DateCreated DATETIME NULL,
	GST MONEY NULL,
	WizardName VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	FieldID VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	FeeItemID INT NULL,
	InputValue VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	Operation INT NULL,
	AdditionalApplicationRequestID INT NULL
)

AS
BEGIN
	-- Fill the table variable with the rows for your result set

	-- Declare Variables
	DECLARE @LicenceID INT
	DECLARE @ApplicationTypeID INT
	DECLARE @Description VARCHAR(MAX)
	IF @AdditionalApplicationRequestID = 0 
		SET @AdditionalApplicationRequestID = NULL

	-- Get Variables from Application Table
	SELECT TOP 1 @LicenceID = A.LicenceID, @ApplicationTypeID = A.ApplicationTypeID, @Description = A.Description FROM Application A  WHERE A.ApplicationID =  @ApplicationID
	
	DECLARE @DtStartDate DATE, @DtEndDate DATE
	DECLARE @TypeOfSkipBin VARCHAR(MAX);
	DECLARE @NoOfBins INT = 0, @Days INT = 0
	DECLARE @isSkipBinApplicable BIT = 0
	DECLARE @FreeDays INT = 0
	DECLARE @AdditionalDays INT = 0
	
	-- Get Variables from Fee Table
	DECLARE @FeeItemName VARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @FeeAmount MONEY = 0.0
	DECLARE @TotalFeeAmount MONEY = 0.0
	
	-- Calculation to check if Base Fee is Applicable
	SELECT @isSkipBinApplicable =
		CASE
			WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1
			ELSE 0
		END
	FROM [dbo].[SkipBin] WHERE ApplicationID = @ApplicationID

	SELECT TOP 1 @TypeOfSkipBin = SBT.Description, @DtStartDate = SB.StartDate, @DtEndDate = SB.EndDate, @NoOfBins = SB.NoOfProposedBins
	FROM SkipBin SB
	JOIN SkipBinTypeItem SBTI ON SBTI.SkipBinID = SB.SkipBinID
	JOIN SkipBinType SBT ON SBT.SkipBinTypeID = SBTI.SkipBinTypeID
	WHERE SB.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
	
	-- Calculation to check if Additional Days Fee is Applicable
	IF(@DtStartDate IS NOT NULL AND @DtEndDate IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		SET @Days = DATEDIFF(DAY,@DtStartDate, @DtEndDate)
	END

	IF(@Days > 0)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @FreeDays =
		CASE
			WHEN @TypeOfSkipBin = 'Residential' THEN 3
			WHEN @TypeOfSkipBin = 'Commercial' THEN 7
		ELSE 0
		END
	END

	IF(@FreeDays > 0 )
	BEGIN
		SET @AdditionalDays = @Days - @FreeDays
	END

	IF(@AdditionalDays > 0)
	BEGIN
		SET @FeeItemID = NULL;
		SET @FeeAmount = 0.0;

		SELECT TOP 1 @FeeItemID = F.FeeItemID FROM FeeItem F
		JOIN FeeItemCategory FC 
		ON F.CategoryID = FC.FeeItemCategoryID
		WHERE FC.Name LIKE '%Skip Bins%' 
		AND F.Description LIKE '%'+''+@TypeOfSkipBin+''+'%'
		AND F.Description LIKE '%Additional%'
		AND F.LicenceID = @LicenceID
		AND F.ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID	

		SELECT @FeeItemName = F.Description, @FeeAmount = F.DefaultAmount FROM FeeItem F WHERE F.FeeItemID = @FeeItemID
		SET @FeeAmount = @FeeAmount * @AdditionalDays;

		IF(@NoOfBins > 0)	
			SET @TotalFeeAmount = @FeeAmount * @NoOfBins
		ELSE
			SET @TotalFeeAmount = @FeeAmount

		IF(@FeeAmount > 0)
		BEGIN				
			--Insert fee into table
			INSERT INTO @ApplicationFee(ApplicationID,FeeItemName,StepID,UnitPrice,Quantity,TotalPrice,DateCreated,GST,WizardName,FieldID,FeeItemID,InputValue,Operation,AdditionalApplicationRequestID)
			SELECT @ApplicationID,@FeeItemName,@StepID,@FeeAmount,ISNULL(NULLIF(@NoOfBins,0),1),@TotalFeeAmount, GETDATE() ,0,@WizzardName,@FieldID,@FeeItemID,@InputValue,@Operation,@AdditionalApplicationRequestID	
		END

	END				
	RETURN 
END

	DECLARE @IsConcessionApplicable BIT = 0;
		-- Regular fees will be applicable by default
	DECLARE @FeeCategory VARCHAR(MAX) = 'Regular'
	DECLARE @AnimalCount INT = 0;

	SELECT 
		@LicenceID = A.LicenceID, 
		@ApplicationTypeID = A.ApplicationTypeID, 
		@Description = A.Description,
		@IsConcessionApplicable = A.OwnerBuilder
	FROM Application A  WHERE A.ApplicationID =  @ApplicationID
	
	-- Check if concession is applicable
	IF(@IsConcessionApplicable = 1)
		SET @FeeCategory = 'Concession'

	-- Get Animal List
	DECLARE @AnimalList TABLE
	(
		AnimalListID INT IDENTITY(1,1),
		AnimalRegisterationID INT,
		Category VARCHAR(MAX),
		Desexed BIT,
		FeeItemID INT,
		FeeItemName VARCHAR(1000),
		UnitPrice MONEY
	)
	INSERT INTO @AnimalList (AnimalRegisterationID,Category)
	SELECT
		AR.AnimalRegistrationId,
		ATPS.Name
		--AR.Desexed		
	FROM AnimalRegistration AR 
	JOIN AnimalType AT ON AT.AnimalTypeId = AR.AnimalTypeId
	JOIN AnimalTypeParticularSetting ATPS ON ATPS.AnimalTypeParticularSettingId  = AR.AnimalTypeParticularSettingId

	AR.ApplicationId = @ApplicationID

	SELECT @AnimalCount = COUNT(AL.AnimalListID) FROM @AnimalList AL

	WHILE (@tempAnimalCountID > 0)

		UPDATE @AnimalList

		WHERE

		SET @CurrentAnimalListID = @CurrentAnimalListID + 1

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Bhavesh H
-- Create date: 11 MARCH 2021
-- Description: Gets the PPAR counter Value for Application (Counter Value when First Decision was Made)
-- =============================================
CREATE function [dbo].[fnGetApplicationCounterForPPARV2]
(
	@ApplicationID INT
)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
-- COUNTER VALUE WHEN FIRST DECISION WAS MADE
DECLARE @CounterValue INT = 0
DECLARE @DateCreated DATE;
-- STATE ID
DECLARE @StateID INT;

-- APPLICATION TYPE FOR VICSMART AND PLANNING PERMIT
DECLARE @PPApplicationTypeID INT;
DECLARE @VSApplicationTypeID INT;

SELECT TOP 1 @PPApplicationTypeID = AT.ApplicationTypeID FROM ApplicationType AT WHERE AT.FSMTypeName LIKE '%TownPlanning%'
SELECT TOP 1 @VSApplicationTypeID = AT.ApplicationTypeID FROM ApplicationType AT WHERE AT.FSMTypeName LIKE '%VicSmart%'

DECLARE @LicenceID INT
DECLARE @ApplicationTypeID INT

-- GET VALUES INTO TEMP VARIABLES FROM APPLICATION TABLE
SELECT TOP 1	
	@ApplicationTypeID = A.ApplicationTypeID,
	@StateID  = L.StateID,
	@DateCreated = A.DateCreated
FROM Application A
JOIN Licence L ON A.LicenceID = L.LicenceID
WHERE A.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID

-- PPAR COUNTER IS ONLY APPLICABLE IF APPLICATION IS HAS BEEN DETERMINED
DECLARE @IsDetermined BIT = 0;
DECLARE @DecisionCount INT = 0;
SELECT @DecisionCount = COUNT(*) FROM Decision D
WHERE D.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID

IF(@DecisionCount > 0)
	SET @IsDetermined = 1

IF(@IsDetermined = 1)
BEGIN
	SELECT TOP 1 
	@CounterValue = PPAR.FirstDecisionCounterValue
	FROM Application A
	JOIN ApplicationPPARDetails PPAR ON A.ApplicationID = PPAR.ApplicationID
	WHERE A.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
	
	-- IF FIRST DECISION COUNTER VALUE IS MISSING WE WILL CALCULATE IT
	IF(@CounterValue = 0 OR @CounterValue IS NULL)
	BEGIN		
		-- GET FIRST DECISION DATE
		DECLARE @FirstDecisionDate DATE;
		SELECT TOP 1 @FirstDecisionDate = D.DateDecision FROM Decision D 
		WHERE D.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID 
		ORDER BY D.DateDecision ASC, D.DecisionID ASC

		-- TRANSITION DETAILS BEFORE DECISION
		DECLARE @PreviousAuditTrailID INT;
		DECLARE @PreviousAuditTrailCounterStatus BIT = NULL;	
		DECLARE @PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue INT = 0;
		DECLARE @PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate DATE;	
		SELECT TOP 1 
			@PreviousAuditTrailID = AT.AuditTrailID,
			@PreviousAuditTrailCounterStatus = 
			CASE
				WHEN AT.CounterStatus LIKE '%on%' THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END,
			@PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue = ISNULL(AT.Counter,0),
			@PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate = CONVERT(DATE,AT.ChangeDate)
		FROM AuditTrail AT
		WHERE AT.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
		AND CONVERT(DATE,AT.ChangeDate) <= @FirstDecisionDate
		AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%jump%'
		AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%application no%'
		AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%migration%'
		ORDER BY AT.ChangeDate DESC, AT.AuditTrailID DESC

		IF(@PreviousAuditTrailID IS NULL)
		BEGIN
			SET @PreviousAuditTrailID = 0;
			SET @PreviousAuditTrailCounterStatus = 0;
			SET @PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue = 0;
			SET @PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate = @DateCreated
		END
		IF(@PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate > @FirstDecisionDate)
			SET @PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate = @FirstDecisionDate

		-- TRANSITION DETAILS AFTER DECISION
		DECLARE @NextAuditTrailID INT;
		DECLARE @NextAuditTrailCounterStatus BIT = NULL;	
		DECLARE @NextAuditTrailCounterValue INT = 0;	
		SELECT TOP 1 
			@NextAuditTrailID = AT.AuditTrailID,
			@NextAuditTrailCounterStatus = 
			CASE
				WHEN AT.CounterStatus LIKE '%on%' THEN 1
				ELSE 0
			END, 
			@NextAuditTrailCounterValue = ISNULL(AT.Counter,0)
		FROM AuditTrail AT
		WHERE AT.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
		AND CONVERT(DATE,AT.ChangeDate) >= @FirstDecisionDate
		AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%jump%'
		AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%application no%'
		AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%migration%'
		ORDER BY AT.ChangeDate ASC, AT.AuditTrailID ASC
	
		IF(ISNULL(@NextAuditTrailCounterStatus,0) = 1)
		BEGIN
			IF(@ApplicationTypeID = @PPApplicationTypeID)
			BEGIN
				SET @CounterValue = @PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue + DATEDIFF(DAY,@PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate,@FirstDecisionDate)
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @DtStartDate DATE, @DtEndDate DATE, @DtCurrentDate DATE;
				SET @DtStartDate = @PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate;
				SET @DtEndDate = @FirstDecisionDate;
				SET @DtCurrentDate = @DtStartDate;
				SET @CounterValue = @PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue;
				-- LOOP THROUGH EACH DAY AND SKIP HOLIDAYS
				WHILE (@DtCurrentDate < @DtEndDate)
				BEGIN
					IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Holiday WHERE HolidayDate = @DtCurrentDate AND ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID AND StateID = @StateID ) 
					BEGIN
						SET @CounterValue = ISNULL(@CounterValue,0) + 1					
					END
					SET @DtCurrentDate = DATEADD(DAY,1,@DtCurrentDate)
				END	
			END
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			SET @CounterValue = @NextAuditTrailCounterValue
		END

	END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	-- RETUNR -9999 WHICH MEANS COUNTER APPLICATION IS NOT DETERMINED
	SET @CounterValue = -9999
END
RETURN @CounterValue

END

RETURNS @ApplicationFee TABLE
(
	ApplicationID INT NULL,
	FeeItemName VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	StepID VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	UnitPrice MONEY NULL,
	Quantity FLOAT NULL,
	TotalPrice MONEY NULL,
	DateCreated DATETIME NULL,
	GST MONEY NULL,
	WizardName VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	FieldID VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	FeeItemID INT NULL,
	InputValue VARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
	Operation INT NULL,
	AdditionalApplicationRequestID INT NULL
)

AS

	-- Fill the table variable with the rows for your result set

	-- Declare Variables
	DECLARE @LicenceID INT
	DECLARE @ApplicationTypeID INT
	DECLARE @CostOfWorks MONEY
	DECLARE @AdditionalCostOfWorks MONEY
	DECLARE @Slab MONEY
	DECLARE @Multiplier MONEY
	DECLARE @AdditionalFeeRate MONEY
	DECLARE @AdditionalFee MONEY
	DECLARE @Description VARCHAR(MAX)
	DECLARE @FeeAmount MONEY
	IF @AdditionalApplicationRequestID = 0 
		SET @AdditionalApplicationRequestID = NULL

	-- Get Variables from Application Table
	SELECT @LicenceID = A.LicenceID, @ApplicationTypeID = A.ApplicationTypeID, @CostOfWorks = A.CostOfDevelopment, @Description = A.Description FROM Application A  WHERE A.ApplicationID =  @ApplicationID

	-- Get Variables from Fee Table
	DECLARE @FeeItemName VARCHAR(MAX)
	SELECT  @FeeItemName = F.Description, @FeeAmount = F.DefaultAmount FROM FeeItem F WHERE F.FeeItemID = @FeeItemID

	--Calculation Logic
	IF(@CostOfWorks < 50000)
	BEGIN
		SET @Multiplier = 0.0
		SET @AdditionalFee = @FeeAmount
		SET @Slab = 0.0
	END
	IF(@CostOfWorks > 50000 AND @CostOfWorks < 500000)
	BEGIN
		SET @Multiplier = 0.0032
		SET @AdditionalFee = 0.0
		SET @Slab = 0
	END
	IF(@CostOfWorks > 500000 AND @CostOfWorks < 2500000)
	BEGIN
		SET @Multiplier = 0.00257
		SET @AdditionalFee = 1700.00
		SET @Slab = 500000
	END
	IF(@CostOfWorks > 2500000 AND @CostOfWorks < 5000000)
	BEGIN
		SET @Multiplier =0.00206
		SET @AdditionalFee = 7161.00
		SET @Slab = 2500000
	END
	IF(@CostOfWorks > 5000000 AND @CostOfWorks < 215000000)
	BEGIN
		SET @Multiplier = 0.00123
		SET @AdditionalFee = 12633.00
		SET @Slab = 5000000
	END
	IF(@CostOfWorks > 215000000)
	BEGIN
		SET @Multiplier = 1
		SET @AdditionalFee = 34196.00
		SET @Slab = 215000000
	END
	SET @AdditionalCostOfWorks = @CostOfWorks - @Slab
	SET @FeeAmount = @AdditionalFee + (@Multiplier * @AdditionalCostOfWorks)

	-- Calulate DA Fees.
	INSERT INTO @ApplicationFee(ApplicationID,FeeItemName,StepID,UnitPrice,Quantity,TotalPrice,DateCreated,GST,WizardName,FieldID,FeeItemID,InputValue,Operation,AdditionalApplicationRequestID)

	RETURN 
END

-- Description: Gets Counter Value for Current Application
-- =============================================
Create function [dbo].[fnGetCurrentCounterValueForApplication]
(
	@ApplicationID INT
)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
-- STATE ID
DECLARE @StateID INT;

--APPLICATION TYPE FOR VICSMART AND PLANNING PERMIT
DECLARE @PPApplicationTypeID INT;
DECLARE @VSApplicationTypeID INT;

SELECT TOP 1 @PPApplicationTypeID = AT.ApplicationTypeID FROM ApplicationType AT WHERE AT.FSMTypeName LIKE '%TownPlanning%'
SELECT TOP 1 @VSApplicationTypeID = AT.ApplicationTypeID FROM ApplicationType AT WHERE AT.FSMTypeName LIKE '%VicSmart%'

DECLARE @ApplicationCounter INT;
DECLARE @CurrentCounterStatus BIT;
DECLARE @ApplicationTypeID INT;
DECLARE @LastStatusChangeDate DATETIME;

DECLARE @NewCounterValue INT;

--GET VALUES INTO TEMP VARIABLES FROM APPLICATION TABLE
SELECT TOP 1
	@ApplicationCounter = ISNULL(A.Counter,0),
	@CurrentCounterStatus =
	CASE
		WHEN LOWER(ISNULL(NULLIF(A.CurrentCounterState,''),'off')) LIKE '%on%' THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END,
	@ApplicationTypeID = A.ApplicationTypeID,
	@StateID  = L.StateID
FROM Application A
JOIN Licence L ON A.LicenceID = L.LicenceID
WHERE A.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID

-- NEW COUNTER VALUE MUST BE CALCULATED ONLY IF CURRENT COUNTER STATE IS 'ON'
IF(@CurrentCounterStatus = 1)
BEGIN
	-- IF COUNTER STATE IS ON FORMULA TO GET CURRENT COUNTER VALUE WILL BE  : APPLICATION COUNTER + (TODAY'S DATE - LAST STATUS CHANGE DATE)
	
	-- GET LAST STATUS CHANGE DATE FROM AUDIT TRAIL
	SELECT TOP 1
	@LastStatusChangeDate = AT.ChangeDate
	FROM AuditTrail AT
	WHERE AT.ApplicationID  = @ApplicationID
	AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%jump%'
	AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%Application No%'
	AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%Migration%'
	ORDER BY AT.ChangeDate DESC, AT.AuditTrailID DESC

	-- FOR PP HOLIDAYS ARE NOT CONSIDERED 
	IF(@ApplicationTypeID = @PPApplicationTypeID)
	BEGIN
		SET @NewCounterValue = @ApplicationCounter + DATEDIFF(DAY,@LastStatusChangeDate,GETDATE())
	END
	-- FOR VS HOLIDAYS ARE CONSIDERED
	ELSE IF(@ApplicationTypeID = @VSApplicationTypeID)
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @DtStartDate DATE, @DtEndDate DATE, @DtCurrentDate DATE;
		SET @DtStartDate = @LastStatusChangeDate;
		SET @DtEndDate = GETDATE();
		SET @DtCurrentDate = @DtStartDate;
		SET @NewCounterValue = @ApplicationCounter;
		-- LOOP THROUGH EACH DAY AND SKIP HOLIDAYS
		WHILE (@DtCurrentDate < @DtEndDate)
		BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Holiday WHERE HolidayDate = @DtCurrentDate AND ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID AND StateID = @StateID ) 
			BEGIN
				SET @NewCounterValue = ISNULL(@NewCounterValue,0) + 1					
			END
			SET @DtCurrentDate = DATEADD(DAY,1,@DtCurrentDate)
		END			
	END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @NewCounterValue = @ApplicationCounter
END
RETURN @NewCounterValue

END

BEGIN

	IF(NULLIF(@OrderBy,'') IS NULL)
	BEGIN

	END

	-- Add the T-SQL statements to compute the return value here
	IF(@OrderBy = 'DESC')
	BEGIN
		SELECT

		FROM Fee F

		ORDER BY F.DateReceived DESC

		WHERE F.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID

	SELECT TOP 1 @LicenceID = A.LicenceID, @ApplicationTypeID = A.ApplicationTypeID, @Description = A.Description FROM Application A  WHERE A.ApplicationID =  @ApplicationID

	DECLARE @isRoadOccupationApplicable BIT = 0
	DECLARE @SqFt FLOAT = 0
	SELECT @isRoadOccupationApplicable =
		CASE
		WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1
		ELSE 0
		END	
	FROM RoadOccupation RO
	JOIN RoadOccupationTypeItem ROT ON RO.RoadOccupationID = ROT.RoadOccupationID
	WHERE RO.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID

	SELECT TOP 1 @SqFt = RO.NoOfMeters
	FROM RoadOccupation RO
	JOIN RoadOccupationTypeItem ROT ON RO.RoadOccupationID = ROT.RoadOccupationID
	WHERE RO.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
	
	-- Get Variables from Fee Table
		DECLARE @FeeItemName VARCHAR(MAX)
		DECLARE @FeeAmount MONEY = 0.0

		WHEN @TypeOfVehicleCrossing LIKE '%Residential%' THEN 'Residential'
		WHEN @TypeOfVehicleCrossing LIKE '%Industrial%' THEN 'Industrial'
	ELSE 'Others'
	END;

	SELECT TOP 1 @FeeItemID = F.FeeItemID FROM FeeItem F
	JOIN FeeItemCategory FC 
	ON F.CategoryID = FC.FeeItemCategoryID
	WHERE FC.Name LIKE '%Vehicle Crossing%' 
	AND F.Description LIKE '%'+''+@FeeType+''+'%'
	AND F.LicenceID = @LicenceID
	AND F.ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID	
	
	
	-- Get Variables from Fee Table
		DECLARE @FeeItemName VARCHAR(MAX)

	BEGIN

	IF(@NoOfVehicleCrossing > 0 AND @FeeAmount > 0)

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetFeesByFeeItemAndFeeType]
(

	@FeeItem VARCHAR(MAX),
	@FeeTypeID INT,
	@FeeStatus VARCHAR (500)
)
RETURNS MONEY
AS
BEGIN
	-- Declare the return variable here
	DECLARE @Result_TotalFeeAmount MONEY
	SET @Result_TotalFeeAmount = 0.0;
	
	IF(LOWER(@FeeStatus) = 'paid')
	BEGIN

		FROM Fee F
		WHERE

-- =============================================
-- Author:		Bhavesh H.
-- Create date: 2021-08-13
-- Description:	Returns the Median Value for the given date range
-- =============================================
CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnGetProcessingDayMedianByMonth] 
(
	@DtStartDate DATE,
	@DtEndDate DATE,
	@LicenceID INT
)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN

	DECLARE @TempTable TABLE
	(
	TempTableID INT IDENTITY(1,1),
	CounterDay INT
	)
	INSERT INTO @TempTable (CounterDay)
	SELECT DATEDIFF(DAY,A.DateCreated,D.ResponsibleAuthorityOutcomeDate) FROM Application  A
	JOIN ApplicationPPARDetails D ON A.ApplicationID = D.ApplicationID
	WHERE 
	D.ResponsibleAuthorityOutcomeDate BETWEEN @DtStartDate AND @DtEndDate
	AND A.LicenceID = @LicenceID
	AND A.ApplicationTypeID IN( 1,16)
	AND A.ApplicationNo NOT LIKE  '%TEST%'
	ORDER BY DATEDIFF(DAY,A.DateCreated,D.ResponsibleAuthorityOutcomeDate)

	DECLARE @N INT = 0;
	DECLARE @Median INT  = 0;

	SELECT @N = COUNT(*) FROM @TempTable

	DECLARE @MidNum INT = 0
	SET @MidNum = @N / 2;

	IF(@N % 2 =0)
	BEGIN
	DECLARE @Num1 INT, @Num2 INT = 0	
	SELECT TOP 1 @Num1 = CounterDay FROM @TempTable  WHERE TempTableID = @MidNum
	SELECT TOP 1 @Num2 = CounterDay FROM @TempTable  WHERE TempTableID = @MidNum+1
	SET @Median = (@Num1 + @Num2) / 2
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN	
	SELECT TOP 1 @Median = CounterDay FROM @TempTable  WHERE TempTableID = @MidNum+1
	END

RETURN @Median

END

-- =============================================
CREATE function [dbo].[fnGetStatutoryCounterByDate]
(
	@ApplicationID INT,
	@DecisionDate DATE,
	@PPApplicationTypeID INT,
	@VSApplicationTypeID INT
)
RETURNS INT
AS
BEGIN
-- COUNTER VALUE WHEN FIRST DECISION WAS MADE
DECLARE @CounterValue INT = 0
DECLARE @DateCreated DATE;
-- STATE ID
DECLARE @StateID INT;
DECLARE @ApplicationTypeID INT, @LicenceID INT


-- GET VALUES INTO TEMP VARIABLES FROM APPLICATION TABLE
SELECT TOP 1	
	@ApplicationTypeID = A.ApplicationTypeID,
	@StateID  = L.StateID,
	@DateCreated = A.DateCreated,
	@LicenceID = A.LicenceID
FROM Application A
JOIN Licence L ON A.LicenceID = L.LicenceID
WHERE A.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID

-- TRANSITION DETAILS BEFORE DECISION
DECLARE @PreviousAuditTrailID INT;
DECLARE @PreviousAuditTrailCounterStatus BIT = NULL;	
DECLARE @PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue INT = 0;
DECLARE @PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate DATE;	
SELECT TOP 1 
	@PreviousAuditTrailID = AT.AuditTrailID,
	@PreviousAuditTrailCounterStatus = 
	CASE
		WHEN AT.CounterStatus LIKE '%on%' THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END,
	@PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue = ISNULL(AT.Counter,0),
	@PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate = CONVERT(DATE,AT.ChangeDate)
FROM AuditTrail AT
WHERE AT.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
AND CONVERT(DATE,AT.ChangeDate) <= @DecisionDate
AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%jump%'
AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%application no%'
AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%migration%'
ORDER BY AT.ChangeDate DESC, AT.AuditTrailID DESC

-- IF NO PREVIOUS TRANSITION IS FOUND
IF(@PreviousAuditTrailID IS NULL)
BEGIN
	SET @PreviousAuditTrailID = 0;
	SET @PreviousAuditTrailCounterStatus = 0;
	SET @PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue = 0;
	SET @PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate = @DateCreated
END

IF(@PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate > @DecisionDate)
	SET @PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate = @DecisionDate

-- TRANSITION DETAILS AFTER DECISION
DECLARE @NextAuditTrailID INT;
DECLARE @NextAuditTrailCounterStatus BIT = NULL;	
DECLARE @NextAuditTrailCounterValue INT = 0;	
SELECT TOP 1 
	@NextAuditTrailID = AT.AuditTrailID,
	@NextAuditTrailCounterStatus = 
	CASE
		WHEN AT.CounterStatus LIKE '%on%' THEN 1
		ELSE 0
	END, 
	@NextAuditTrailCounterValue = ISNULL(AT.Counter,0)
FROM AuditTrail AT
WHERE AT.ApplicationID = @ApplicationID
AND CONVERT(DATE,AT.ChangeDate) >= @DecisionDate
AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%jump%'
AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%application no%'
AND LOWER(AT.Transition) NOT LIKE '%migration%'
ORDER BY AT.ChangeDate ASC, AT.AuditTrailID ASC

-- CHECK IF THE COUNTER STATUS WAS "ON"	ON THAT PARTICULAR DATE
IF(ISNULL(@NextAuditTrailCounterStatus,0) = 1)
BEGIN
	IF(@ApplicationTypeID = @PPApplicationTypeID)
	BEGIN
		SET @CounterValue = @PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue + DATEDIFF(DAY,@PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate,@DecisionDate)
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @DtStartDate DATE, @DtEndDate DATE, @DtCurrentDate DATE;
		SET @DtStartDate = @PreviousAuditTrailChangeDate;
		SET @DtEndDate = @DecisionDate;
		SET @DtCurrentDate = @DtStartDate;
		SET @CounterValue = @PreviousAuditTrailCounterValue;
		-- LOOP THROUGH EACH DAY AND SKIP HOLIDAYS
		WHILE (@DtCurrentDate < @DtEndDate)
		BEGIN
			IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM Holiday WHERE HolidayDate = @DtCurrentDate AND ApplicationTypeID = @ApplicationTypeID AND StateID = @StateID ) 
			BEGIN
				SET @CounterValue = ISNULL(@CounterValue,0) + 1					
			END
			SET @DtCurrentDate = DATEADD(DAY,1,@DtCurrentDate)
		END	
	END
END
ELSE
BEGIN
	SET @CounterValue = @NextAuditTrailCounterValue
END

RETURN @CounterValue

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnIntegerToWords](@Number as BIGINT) 
    RETURNS VARCHAR(1024)
AS

BEGIN
      DECLARE @Below20 TABLE (ID int identity(0,1), Word varchar(32))
      DECLARE @Below100 TABLE (ID int identity(2,1), Word varchar(32))
      INSERT @Below20 (Word) VALUES 
                        ( 'Zero'), ('One'),( 'Two' ), ( 'Three'),
                        ( 'Four' ), ( 'Five' ), ( 'Six' ), ( 'Seven' ),
                        ( 'Eight'), ( 'Nine'), ( 'Ten'), ( 'Eleven' ),
                        ( 'Twelve' ), ( 'Thirteen' ), ( 'Fourteen'),
                        ( 'Fifteen' ), ('Sixteen' ), ( 'Seventeen'),
                        ('Eighteen' ), ( 'Nineteen' ) 

       INSERT @Below100 VALUES ('Twenty'), ('Thirty'),('Forty'), ('Fifty'),
                               ('Sixty'), ('Seventy'), ('Eighty'), ('Ninety')

    declare @belowHundred as varchar(126) 

    if @Number > 99 begin
        select @belowHundred = dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number % 100)
    end

    DECLARE @English varchar(1024) = 

    (

      SELECT Case 
        WHEN @Number = 0 THEN  ''

        WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1 AND 19 
          THEN (SELECT Word FROM @Below20 WHERE ID=@Number)

       WHEN @Number BETWEEN 20 AND 99   
         THEN  (SELECT Word FROM @Below100 WHERE ID=@Number/10)+ '-' +
               dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number % 10) 

       WHEN @Number BETWEEN 100 AND 999   
         THEN  (dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number / 100)) +' Hundred '+
             Case WHEN @belowHundred <> '' THEN 'and ' + @belowHundred else @belowHundred end 

       WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000 AND 999999   
         THEN  (dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number / 1000))+' Thousand '+
             dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number % 1000)  

       WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000000 AND 999999999   
         THEN  (dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number / 1000000))+' Million '+
             dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number % 1000000) 

       WHEN @Number BETWEEN 1000000000 AND 999999999999   
         THEN  (dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number / 1000000000))+' Billion '+
             dbo.fnIntegerToWords( @Number % 1000000000) 

            ELSE ' INVALID INPUT' END
    )

    SELECT @English = RTRIM(@English)

    SELECT @English = RTRIM(LEFT(@English,len(@English)-1))
        WHERE RIGHT(@English,1)='-'

    RETURN (@English)

END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[fnSplitString]
(    
      @Input NVARCHAR(MAX),
      @Character CHAR(1)
)
RETURNS @Output TABLE (
	  Id INT NOT NULL IDENTITY(1,1),
      Item NVARCHAR(1000)
)
AS
BEGIN
      DECLARE @StartIndex INT, @EndIndex INT
 
      SET @StartIndex = 1
      IF SUBSTRING(@Input, LEN(@Input) - 1, LEN(@Input)) <> @Character
      BEGIN
            SET @Input = @Input + @Character
      END
 
      WHILE CHARINDEX(@Character, @Input) > 0
      BEGIN
            SET @EndIndex = CHARINDEX(@Character, @Input)
           
            INSERT INTO @Output(Item)
            SELECT SUBSTRING(@Input, @StartIndex, @EndIndex - 1)
           
            SET @Input = SUBSTRING(@Input, @EndIndex + 1, LEN(@Input))
      END
 
      RETURN
END

CREATE FUNCTION dbo.parseJSON( @JSON NVARCHAR(MAX))
/**
Summary: >
  The code for the JSON Parser/Shredder will run in SQL Server 2005, 
  and even in SQL Server 2000 (with some modifications required).
 
  First the function replaces all strings with tokens of the form @Stringxx,
  where xx is the foreign key of the table variable where the strings are held.
  This takes them, and their potentially difficult embedded brackets, out of 
  the way. Names are  always strings in JSON as well as  string values.
 
  Then, the routine iteratively finds the next structure that has no structure 
  Contained within it, (and is, by definition the leaf structure), and parses it,
  replacing it with an object token of the form ‘@Objectxxx‘, or ‘@arrayxxx‘, 
  where xxx is the object id assigned to it. The values, or name/value pairs 
  are retrieved from the string table and stored in the hierarchy table. G
  radually, the JSON document is eaten until there is just a single root
  object left.
Author: PhilFactor
Date: 01/07/2010
Version: 
  Number: 4.6.2
  Date: 01/07/2019
  Why: case-insensitive version
Example: >
  Select * from parseJSON('{    "Person": 
      {
       "firstName": "John",
       "lastName": "Smith",
       "age": 25,
       "Address": 
           {
          "streetAddress":"21 2nd Street",
          "city":"New York",
          "state":"NY",
          "postalCode":"10021"
           },
       "PhoneNumbers": 
           {
           "home":"212 555-1234",
          "fax":"646 555-4567"
           }
        }
     }
  ')
Returns: >
  nothing
**/
	RETURNS @hierarchy TABLE
	  (
	   Element_ID INT IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL, /* internal surrogate primary key gives the order of parsing and the list order */
	   SequenceNo [int] NULL, /* the place in the sequence for the element */
	   Parent_ID INT null, /* if the element has a parent then it is in this column. The document is the ultimate parent, so you can get the structure from recursing from the document */
	   Object_ID INT null, /* each list or object has an object id. This ties all elements to a parent. Lists are treated as objects here */
	   Name NVARCHAR(2000) NULL, /* the Name of the object */
	   StringValue NVARCHAR(MAX) NOT NULL,/*the string representation of the value of the element. */
	   ValueType VARCHAR(10) NOT null /* the declared type of the value represented as a string in StringValue*/
	  )
	  /*
 
	   */
	AS
	BEGIN
	  DECLARE
	    @FirstObject INT, --the index of the first open bracket found in the JSON string
	    @OpenDelimiter INT,--the index of the next open bracket found in the JSON string
	    @NextOpenDelimiter INT,--the index of subsequent open bracket found in the JSON string
	    @NextCloseDelimiter INT,--the index of subsequent close bracket found in the JSON string
	    @Type NVARCHAR(10),--whether it denotes an object or an array
	    @NextCloseDelimiterChar CHAR(1),--either a '}' or a ']'
	    @Contents NVARCHAR(MAX), --the unparsed contents of the bracketed expression
	    @Start INT, --index of the start of the token that you are parsing
	    @end INT,--index of the end of the token that you are parsing
	    @param INT,--the parameter at the end of the next Object/Array token
	    @EndOfName INT,--the index of the start of the parameter at end of Object/Array token
	    @token NVARCHAR(200),--either a string or object
	    @value NVARCHAR(MAX), -- the value as a string
	    @SequenceNo int, -- the sequence number within a list
	    @Name NVARCHAR(200), --the Name as a string
	    @Parent_ID INT,--the next parent ID to allocate
	    @lenJSON INT,--the current length of the JSON String
	    @characters NCHAR(36),--used to convert hex to decimal
	    @result BIGINT,--the value of the hex symbol being parsed
	    @index SMALLINT,--used for parsing the hex value
	    @Escape INT --the index of the next escape character
	    
	  DECLARE @Strings TABLE /* in this temporary table we keep all strings, even the Names of the elements, since they are 'escaped' in a different way, and may contain, unescaped, brackets denoting objects or lists. These are replaced in the JSON string by tokens representing the string */
	    (
	     String_ID INT IDENTITY(1, 1),
	     StringValue NVARCHAR(MAX)
	    )
	  SELECT--initialise the characters to convert hex to ascii
	    @characters='0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz',
	    @SequenceNo=0, --set the sequence no. to something sensible.
	  /* firstly we process all strings. This is done because [{} and ] aren't escaped in strings, which complicates an iterative parse. */
	    @Parent_ID=0;
	  WHILE 1=1 --forever until there is nothing more to do
	    BEGIN
	      SELECT
	        @start=PATINDEX('%[^a-zA-Z]["]%', @json collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin);--next delimited string
	      IF @start=0 BREAK --no more so drop through the WHILE loop
	      IF SUBSTRING(@json, @start+1, 1)='"' 
	        BEGIN --Delimited Name
	          SET @start=@Start+1;
	          SET @end=PATINDEX('%[^\]["]%', RIGHT(@json, LEN(@json+'|')-@start) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin);
	        END
	      IF @end=0 --either the end or no end delimiter to last string
	        BEGIN-- check if ending with a double slash...
             SET @end=PATINDEX('%[\][\]["]%', RIGHT(@json, LEN(@json+'|')-@start) collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin);
 		     IF @end=0 --we really have reached the end 
				BEGIN
				BREAK --assume all tokens found
				END
			END 
	      SELECT @token=SUBSTRING(@json, @start+1, @end-1)
	      --now put in the escaped control characters
	      SELECT @token=REPLACE(@token, FromString, ToString)
	      FROM
	        (SELECT           '\b', CHAR(08)
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\f', CHAR(12)
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\n', CHAR(10)
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\r', CHAR(13)
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\t', CHAR(09)
			 UNION ALL SELECT '\"', '"'
	         UNION ALL SELECT '\/', '/'
	        ) substitutions(FromString, ToString)
		SELECT @token=Replace(@token, '\\', '\')
	      SELECT @result=0, @escape=1
	  --Begin to take out any hex escape codes
	      WHILE @escape>0
	        BEGIN
	          SELECT @index=0,
	          --find the next hex escape sequence
	          @escape=PATINDEX('%\x[0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f][0-9a-f]%', @token collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)
	          IF @escape>0 --if there is one
	            BEGIN
	              WHILE @index<4 --there are always four digits to a \x sequence   
	                BEGIN
	                  SELECT --determine its value
	                    @result=@result+POWER(16, @index)
	                    *(CHARINDEX(SUBSTRING(@token, @escape+2+3-@index, 1),
	                                @characters)-1), @index=@index+1 ;
	         
	                END
	                -- and replace the hex sequence by its unicode value
	              SELECT @token=STUFF(@token, @escape, 6, NCHAR(@result))
	            END
	        END
	      --now store the string away 
	      INSERT INTO @Strings (StringValue) SELECT @token
	      -- and replace the string with a token
	      SELECT @JSON=STUFF(@json, @start, @end+1,
	                    '@string'+CONVERT(NCHAR(5), @@identity))
	    END
	  -- all strings are now removed. Now we find the first leaf.  
	  WHILE 1=1  --forever until there is nothing more to do
	  BEGIN
	 
	  SELECT @Parent_ID=@Parent_ID+1
	  --find the first object or list by looking for the open bracket
	  SELECT @FirstObject=PATINDEX('%[{[[]%', @json collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)--object or array
	  IF @FirstObject = 0 BREAK
	  IF (SUBSTRING(@json, @FirstObject, 1)='{') 
	    SELECT @NextCloseDelimiterChar='}', @type='object'
	  ELSE 
	    SELECT @NextCloseDelimiterChar=']', @type='array'
	  SELECT @OpenDelimiter=@firstObject
	  WHILE 1=1 --find the innermost object or list...
	    BEGIN
	      SELECT
	        @lenJSON=LEN(@JSON+'|')-1
	  --find the matching close-delimiter proceeding after the open-delimiter
	      SELECT
	        @NextCloseDelimiter=CHARINDEX(@NextCloseDelimiterChar, @json,
	                                      @OpenDelimiter+1)
	  --is there an intervening open-delimiter of either type
	      SELECT @NextOpenDelimiter=PATINDEX('%[{[[]%',
	             RIGHT(@json, @lenJSON-@OpenDelimiter)collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)--object
	      IF @NextOpenDelimiter=0 
	        BREAK
	      SELECT @NextOpenDelimiter=@NextOpenDelimiter+@OpenDelimiter
	      IF @NextCloseDelimiter<@NextOpenDelimiter 
	        BREAK
	      IF SUBSTRING(@json, @NextOpenDelimiter, 1)='{' 
	        SELECT @NextCloseDelimiterChar='}', @type='object'
	      ELSE 
	        SELECT @NextCloseDelimiterChar=']', @type='array'
	      SELECT @OpenDelimiter=@NextOpenDelimiter
	    END
	  ---and parse out the list or Name/value pairs
	  SELECT
	    @contents=SUBSTRING(@json, @OpenDelimiter+1,
	                        @NextCloseDelimiter-@OpenDelimiter-1)
	  SELECT
	    @JSON=STUFF(@json, @OpenDelimiter,
	                @NextCloseDelimiter-@OpenDelimiter+1,
	                '@'+@type+CONVERT(NCHAR(5), @Parent_ID))
	  WHILE (PATINDEX('%[A-Za-z0-9@+.e]%', @contents collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin))<>0 
	    BEGIN
	      IF @Type='object' --it will be a 0-n list containing a string followed by a string, number,boolean, or null
	        BEGIN
	          SELECT
	            @SequenceNo=0,@end=CHARINDEX(':', ' '+@contents)--if there is anything, it will be a string-based Name.
	          SELECT  @start=PATINDEX('%[^A-Za-z@][@]%', ' '+@contents collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)--AAAAAAAA
              SELECT @token=RTrim(Substring(' '+@contents, @start+1, @End-@Start-1)),
	            @endofName=PATINDEX('%[0-9]%', @token collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin),
	            @param=RIGHT(@token, LEN(@token)-@endofName+1)
	          SELECT
	            @token=LEFT(@token, @endofName-1),
	            @Contents=RIGHT(' '+@contents, LEN(' '+@contents+'|')-@end-1)
	          SELECT  @Name=StringValue FROM @strings
	            WHERE string_id=@param --fetch the Name
	        END
	      ELSE 
	        SELECT @Name=null,@SequenceNo=@SequenceNo+1 
	      SELECT
	        @end=CHARINDEX(',', @contents)-- a string-token, object-token, list-token, number,boolean, or null
                IF @end=0
	        --HR Engineering notation bugfix start
	          IF ISNUMERIC(@contents) = 1
		    SELECT @end = LEN(@contents) + 1
	          Else
	        --HR Engineering notation bugfix end 
		  SELECT  @end=PATINDEX('%[A-Za-z0-9@+.e][^A-Za-z0-9@+.e]%', @contents+' ' collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin) + 1
	       SELECT
	        @start=PATINDEX('%[^A-Za-z0-9@+.e][A-Za-z0-9@+.e]%', ' '+@contents collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)
	      --select @start,@end, LEN(@contents+'|'), @contents  
	      SELECT
	        @Value=RTRIM(SUBSTRING(@contents, @start, @End-@Start)),
	        @Contents=RIGHT(@contents+' ', LEN(@contents+'|')-@end)
	      IF SUBSTRING(@value, 1, 7)='@object' 
	        INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	          (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, Object_ID, ValueType)
	          SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, SUBSTRING(@value, 8, 5),
	            SUBSTRING(@value, 8, 5), 'object' 
	      ELSE 
	        IF SUBSTRING(@value, 1, 6)='@array' 
	          INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	            (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, Object_ID, ValueType)
	            SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, SUBSTRING(@value, 7, 5),
	              SUBSTRING(@value, 7, 5), 'array' 
	        ELSE 
	          IF SUBSTRING(@value, 1, 7)='@string' 
	            INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	              (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	              SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, StringValue, 'string'
	              FROM @strings
	              WHERE string_id=SUBSTRING(@value, 8, 5)
	          ELSE 
	            IF @value IN ('true', 'false') 
	              INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	                (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	                SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, @value, 'boolean'
	            ELSE
	              IF @value='null' 
	                INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	                  (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	                  SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, @value, 'null'
	              ELSE
	                IF PATINDEX('%[^0-9]%', @value collate SQL_Latin1_General_CP850_Bin)>0 
	                  INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	                    (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	                    SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, @value, 'real'
	                ELSE
	                  INSERT INTO @hierarchy
	                    (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, ValueType)
	                    SELECT @Name, @SequenceNo, @Parent_ID, @value, 'int'
	      if @Contents=' ' Select @SequenceNo=0
	    END
	  END
	INSERT INTO @hierarchy (Name, SequenceNo, Parent_ID, StringValue, Object_ID, ValueType)
	  SELECT '-',1, NULL, '', @Parent_ID-1, @type
	--
	   RETURN
	END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[SpaceBeforeCap]
(
 @str nvarchar(max)
)
returns nvarchar(max)
as
begin

declare @i int, @j int
declare @returnval nvarchar(max)
set @returnval = ''
select @i = 1, @j = len(@str)

declare @w nvarchar(max)

while @i <= @j
begin
 if substring(@str,@i,1) = UPPER(substring(@str,@i,1)) collate Latin1_General_CS_AS
 begin
  if @w is not null
  set @returnval = @returnval + ' ' + @w
  set @w = substring(@str,@i,1)
 end
 else
  set @w = @w + substring(@str,@i,1)
 set @i = @i + 1
end
if @w is not null
 set @returnval = @returnval + ' ' + @w

return ltrim(@returnval)

end

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[SPLIT] 
   (  @DELIMITER VARCHAR(500), 
      @LIST      VARCHAR(MAX) 
   ) 
   RETURNS @TABLEOFVALUES TABLE 
      (  ROWID   SMALLINT IDENTITY(1,1), 
         [VALUE] VARCHAR(MAX) 
      ) 
AS 
   BEGIN
    
      DECLARE @LENSTRING INT 
	  DECLARE @DELIMIETERLEN INT
	  SET @DELIMIETERLEN = LEN(@DELIMITER);

      WHILE LEN( @LIST ) > 0 
         BEGIN 
         
            SELECT @LENSTRING = 
               (CASE CHARINDEX( @DELIMITER, @LIST ) 
                   WHEN 0 THEN LEN( @LIST ) 
                   ELSE ( CHARINDEX( @DELIMITER, @LIST ) -@DELIMIETERLEN )
                END
               ) 
                                
            INSERT INTO @TABLEOFVALUES 
               SELECT SUBSTRING( @LIST, @DELIMIETERLEN, @LENSTRING )
                
            SELECT @LIST = 
               (CASE ( LEN( @LIST ) - @LENSTRING ) 
                   WHEN 0 THEN '' 
                   ELSE RIGHT( @LIST, LEN( @LIST ) - @LENSTRING - @DELIMIETERLEN ) 
                END
               ) 
         END
          
      RETURN 
      
   END

CREATE FUNCTION [dbo].[splitstring] ( @stringToSplit VARCHAR(MAX) )
RETURNS
 @returnList TABLE ([Value] [nvarchar] (500))
AS
BEGIN

 DECLARE @value NVARCHAR(255)
 DECLARE @pos INT

 WHILE CHARINDEX('#', @stringToSplit) > 0
 BEGIN
  SELECT @pos  = CHARINDEX('#', @stringToSplit)  
  SELECT @value = SUBSTRING(@stringToSplit, 1, @pos-1)

  INSERT INTO @returnList 
  SELECT @value

  SELECT @stringToSplit = SUBSTRING(@stringToSplit, @pos+1, LEN(@stringToSplit)-@pos)
 END

 INSERT INTO @returnList
 SELECT @stringToSplit

 RETURN
END

CREATE function [dbo].[StripHTML]( @text varchar(max) ) returns varchar(max) as
begin
    declare @textXML xml
    declare @result varchar(max)
    set @textXML = REPLACE( @text, '&', '' );
    with doc(contents) as
    (
        select chunks.chunk.query('.') from @textXML.nodes('/') as chunks(chunk)
    )
    select @result = contents.value('.', 'varchar(max)') from doc
    return @result
end
